evaluator_configuration.prompt_hash: will be computed from ATTACK_PROMPT in adversarial.py

MECHANISM_VALID.description: Source-supported mechanism that is scientifically valid

TRANSFER_VALID.description: Documented mechanism in another context with evidence supporting transfer relevance

BOUNDARY_CONDITION.description: Actual documented failure threshold/limit with external evidence

NON_BOUNDARY.description: Candidate that does NOT cross a documented boundary — should NOT be killed

SPECIFIC_PRIOR_ART.description: Actual patent/application with exact claim/passage disclosing the target combination

TOPICAL_ONLY_PRIOR_ART.description: Related topic/device/mechanism but NO specific disclosure — prior-art firewall should prevent KILL

OBVIOUSNESS_NON_OBVIOUSNESS.description: Independently grounded technical combination — obvious cases KILL, non-obvious cases SURVIVE

scoring_rules.incorrect: production verdict does NOT match expected_verdict
scoring_rules.evaluator_call_failed: not a classification — excluded from accuracy denominator
scoring_rules.false_kill: production returns KILL when expected is SURVIVE
scoring_rules.false_survival: production returns SURVIVE/PASS when expected is KILL

oracle_independence_rule.ground_truth_source: external evidence only (published records, patents, papers, standards)
oracle_independence_rule.independent_review: second evaluator reviews oracle cases without production prompt

no_tuning_after_results.if_fails: report failure mode, do not move goalposts

invariants: Protocol frozen BEFORE first calibration API call
All 35 cases run through production adversarial_challenge()
Evaluator failures are EVALUATOR_CALL_FAILED, never KILL
